ROOMMATE AGREEMENT

This Roommate Agreement (this "Agreement") is made on June 1, 2026 among Alex Chen, Sam Ortiz and Jordan Blake (each a "Roommate" and together the "Roommates"), who live together at 14 Elm Street, Apartment 3B, Columbus, Ohio (the "Apartment").

1. The Lease. The Roommates are all tenants under a lease with Elm Street Properties LLC (the "Landlord") dated May 15, 2026, which runs from June 1, 2026 to May 31, 2027 (the "Lease"). Each Roommate will comply with the Lease. This Agreement is among the Roommates only. It does not change the Lease, and it does not change what any Roommate owes the Landlord.

2. Rent. The monthly rent under the Lease is $2,400. Each Roommate will pay one-third of the rent, which is $800 per month. Each Roommate will send that share to Alex Chen by the 28th day of each month, and Alex Chen will pay the Landlord the full rent when it is due on the first day of the month.

3. Utilities. Electricity, gas and internet are split equally among the Roommates. Sam Ortiz holds the accounts, will share each bill within three days after receiving it, and will be paid each other Roommate's share within seven days after that.

4. Security Deposit. The security deposit under the Lease is $2,400. Each Roommate paid $800 of it. A deduction for damage to one Roommate's bedroom is charged to that Roommate. Any other deduction is shared equally. When the Landlord returns the deposit, each Roommate will receive that Roommate's share, less that Roommate's deductions.

5. Moving Out Early. A Roommate who wants to move out before the Lease ends must give the other Roommates at least 30 days' written notice. That Roommate remains responsible for one-third of the rent and utilities until the Lease ends or a replacement roommate takes over the share, whichever happens first.

6. Replacement Roommate. The departing Roommate is responsible for finding a replacement roommate. The remaining Roommates must approve the replacement, and will not unreasonably refuse. The replacement must also be approved by the Landlord and added to the Lease, as the Lease requires. When the replacement has paid a deposit share of $800, the departing Roommate will be paid back that Roommate's share of the deposit, less that Roommate's deductions.

7. Shared Spaces. Each Roommate will clean up the kitchen and living room after using them. The Roommates will take turns cleaning the bathroom each week. Quiet hours are from 10:00 pm to 7:00 am on weeknights.

8. Guests. A Roommate may have an overnight guest for up to three nights in a week. A longer stay needs the agreement of the other Roommates.

9. Disagreements. The Roommates will try to settle any disagreement about this Agreement by talking it through together before taking any other step.

Signed:

______________________
Alex Chen

______________________
Sam Ortiz

______________________
Jordan Blake
